about: Unique Target is working with market leading equipment manufacturers and constructors and have hands on experience in the operation and maintenance of plants and equipment. We meticulously care for the useful life of assets, maximizing their profitability, streamlining their performance and availability, in turn minimizing their consumption and operating costs.

We offer procurement services based on 7 Rights (Price, Quality, Quantity, Time, Place, Source, and Services). We have experience in supplying vast range of different materials, consumables, and equipment across major industry sectors related to engineering. We also provide experienced and skilled work force to help you execute your projects.
